div.head: II Cn 42
div.ab: Gyf hwa gehadodne man bende oððan beate oððon swyðe gebysmrige, bete wið hine, swa swa hit riht sy, ⁊ bisceope weofodbote be hades mæðe ⁊ hlaforde oððe cyningce be fullan mundbryce; oððe geladige hine mid fulre lade.

Gif hwa hadne man binde oððe beate oððe swiðe gebysmrige, bete wið hine, swa swa hit riht sy, ⁊ biscope wefodbote be hades mæðe ⁊ hlaforde oððe cyninge be fullan mundbrice; oððe geladige hine mid fulle lade.

Si quis ordinatum aliquem uerberibus aut uinculis uel aliquatenus affligat, emendet ei, sicut rectum sit, et episcopo emendationem altaris secundum dignitatem ordinis, regi uel domino plenam infractionem pacis; aut plena lada neget.

Ðæt man gehadodne man [ne] bende ne beate. Gyf hwa gehadodne man bende oððan beate oððon swyðe bismærige, bete wið hine swa hit riht sy, ⁊ ðam bisceope weofodbote be ðæs hades mæðe, ⁊ ðam laforde oððe þam kynincge be fullan mundbryce, oððe geladige hine sylfne mid fulre lade.

Gyf hwa gehadodne man bende oððon beate oððon swyðe gebysmrige, bete wið hine, swa swa hit riht sy, and bisceope weofodbote be hades mæðe and hlaforde oððe cyningce be fullan mundbryce; oððe geladige hine mid fulre lade.

A man in holy orders shall not be bound or beaten. If anyone binds or beats or deeply insults a man in holy orders, he shall make amends towards him in accordance with the law, and shall pay the fine due to the bishop for sacrilege, in accordance with the rank [of the injured man], and to his lord or to the king the full fine for breach of his mund, or he shall clear himself by the full process of exculpation.

If anyone binds or beats or greatly shames someone in holy orders, he shall make amends to him according to the law, and pay to the bishop the fine for assaulting an ecclesiastic according to the victim’s status, and to his lord or the king the full penalty for the violation of his protection; or he shall exonerate himself by the full oath of exculpation.

If anyone binds or beats or greatly insults a man in holy orders, he is to pay compensation to him as is right, and to the bishop the compensation for [insult to] the altar in proportion to its status, and to the lord or the king the full [fine for] breach of his protection; or he is to clear himself by full process of exculpation.

(Dass man einen geweihten Mann [weder] binde noch schlage. B) Wenn einer einen geweihten Mann bindet oder schlägt oder arg beschimpft, büsse er ihm gegenüber, wie es richtig ist, und dem Bischofe Altarbusse nach dem Grade der Weihe [des Verletzten], und dem [Immunitäts]herrn beziehungsweise dem König durch volle Busse für Bruch der Schutzherrlichkeit; oder er reinige sich durch vollen Reinigungsbeweis.

(That no one bind or beat a man in orders. B) If anyone binds or beats or grossly insults a man in orders, let him make amends to him as is right, and to the bishop with altar-compensation according to the rank of [the injured man's] orders, and to the [immunity-]lord or the king with full compensation for breach of protection; or let him clear himself with a full clearing.
div.note: B adds rubric Đæt man gehadodne man [ne] bende ne beate
